title: Correcting for heat loss
caption: The solution is mixed at 3 minutes. Because the cup loses heat while the reaction happens, the highest reading underestimates the rise. Extrapolating the cooling line back to the moment of mixing gives the true maximum, 27.0 °C: ΔT = 7.0 °C.
alt: Temperature against time: steady at 20 °C for 3 minutes, a sharp rise, then a straight cooling line; the cooling line is extended back to 3 minutes, meeting 27 °C.
description: From 4 min: cooling in a straight line, 0.25 °C per minute.
Extended back to 3 min: 27.0 °C, so ΔT = 7.0 °C.

checks.name: the cooling line extrapolated to the time of mixing gives 27.0 °C
